info.title: Facebook Lead Ads
info.description: Simulated Facebook Lead Ads API for deterministic AutomationBench workflow evaluation.

get.summary: Fetch all leads submitted to a particular Lead Ad form. Returns every submission along with the corresponding form field data.

200.description: {success, ad_id, ad_name, leads: [{id, ad_id, created_time, field_data}], count}

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: The ID of the Lead Ad form whose submissions you want to retrieve.

get.description: Fetch all leads submitted to a particular Lead Ad form. Returns every submission along with the corresponding form field data.

get.summary: Locate a Lead Ad by name within a given ad account. Pass the name query parameter to perform a search by ad name.

parameters.name: adAccountId
parameters.description: The ad account ID (excluding the act_ prefix).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The exact ad name to search for.

get.description: Locate a Lead Ad by name within a given ad account. Pass the name query parameter to perform a search by ad name.

post.summary: Set up a new Lead Ad (instant form) on a Facebook Page. The form collects contact details from users who engage with the ad. Returns the ID of the newly created ad.

200.description: {success, ad: {id, ad_name, status, adset_id, form_id}, ad_id}

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: The Facebook Page ID on which the lead ad will be created.

post.description: Set up a new Lead Ad (instant form) on a Facebook Page. The form collects contact details from users who engage with the ad. Returns the ID of the newly created ad. Request body: Body: {ad_name (required, string — name of the lead ad), adset_id (required, string — the ad set ID to attach the ad to), creative_name (required, string — name for the ad creative), message (required, string — ad body text), link (required, string — destination URL), form (required, string — form/template ID for lead capture), action_type (required, string — call to action; enum: APPLY_NOW|DOWNLOAD|GET_QUOTE|LEARN_MORE|SIGN_UP|SUBSCRIBE), status (required, string — ACTIVE or PAUSED), description (optional, string — ad description), campaign_name (optional, string — campaign to associate)}.

schema.description: Body: {ad_name (required, string — name of the lead ad), adset_id (required, string — the ad set ID to attach the ad to), creative_name (required, string — name for the ad creative), message (required, string — ad body text), link (required, string — destination URL), form (required, string — form/template ID for lead capture), action_type (required, string — call to action; enum: APPLY_NOW|DOWNLOAD|GET_QUOTE|LEARN_MORE|SIGN_UP|SUBSCRIBE), status (required, string — ACTIVE or PAUSED), description (optional, string — ad description), campaign_name (optional, string — campaign to associate)}

status.description: Current delivery state of the ad.

adset_id.description: Identifier of the ad set this ad is grouped under.

id.description: Unique identifier for the lead submission.

ad_id.description: Identifier of the ad that captured this lead.

field_data.description: Collection of {name, values} objects representing the form field responses.

created_time.description: Timestamp of when the lead was submitted.

Lead.description: A contact submission captured through a Facebook Lead Ad form.

status.description: Current running state of the ad.

ad_name.description: Display name of the lead ad.

form_id.description: Identifier of the instant form used to collect lead information.

LeadForm.description: A Facebook Lead Ad instant form used for contact capture.
